research_rationale:
Whole-lifecycle YES claim for EO 11593 (Protection and Enhancement of the Cultural Environment, May 13, 1971, 36 FR 8921), read in full from the held Federal Register text after correcting the packet inventory, which began at section 2(a) and used duplicate-labelled scopes, to the 17 separately decided commands of sections 1, 2 and 3. Every command is a standing duty of federal agencies or the Secretary of the Interior. The dated paragraphs, 2(a) (by July 1, 1973) and 2(e) (by January 1, 1972 and annually thereafter), are deadlines, not ends, and paragraph 2(b) is applied today: the held current 36 CFR 63.1 says the Interior regulations explain determinations of eligibility under section 2(b) of the order and implement sections 1(3) and 2(b), and 36 CFR parts 60, 63 and 68 and many other eCFR parts name the order as of 2026-10-14. No later instrument amending, revoking or superseding it is held (the chain is empty; EO 13006 and EO 13022 recite it without changing it). The U.S. Code edition is current through 2026-10-09; that limit is stated, not filled.
